::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 8th 1893  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 196-7
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
I shall be very happy to have the [Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd)and [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd)manipulated for schools. I should think there would be little to do to the Little Duke as it was written for children. I should have thought the [Lances of Lynwood](cmy_books/cmybook_23.qmd)more suitable than the Dove as being on English history.

I know the Eversley country is full of beauty, I once drove through it. I believe there is rather a complication of trains for coming to Winchester or Shawford, our nearest  station, but if you and [Mrs Craik](people/person_378.qmd)could come and lunch here it would be very pleasant I shall however be at [Miss Moberly](people/person_1025.qmd)’s The Close Winchester all next week

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** [‘Royalty of 5 per cent’](organizations/other_160.qmd) is written in another hand at the top.
